CustomObject.description: Carries a journey event out of a transaction that is about to be rolled back. An @AuraEnabled method that throws discards every DML in its request, so a failure logged in a catch block never survives - which is precisely the row ADHA needs in order to find a stuck customer. Published with PublishImmediately, which is delivered whether or not the transaction commits.
CustomObject.label: ADHA Journey Event
